description.en: Agent skill bundle that turns course, lecture, tutorial, meeting, and talk videos into structured study notes, chaining ffmpeg audio extraction and Whisper transcription into a note-writing workflow with a chapter outline, emphasis markers, and a quick-reference card.
description.zh: 把课程、讲座、教程、会议、演讲等视频整理成结构化学习笔记的技能包：用 ffmpeg 提取音轨、Whisper 语音转文字，再生成带分段大纲、重点标记和速查卡的笔记。
